_comment: day-rhythm-business-and-combat ticket 14: bounded solo combat prototype (rules per ticket 13a) -- prototype-only, NOT production balance, not cross-referenced by REFERENCE.md. encounterOrder is the fixed brawler -> knifeFighter -> enforcer teaching sequence; those three entries keep ticket 14's original flat single-enemy shape (name/hp/attackMin/attackMax/speed/evadeChance/script at the encounter's own top level) for backward compatibility -- CombatPrototype._current_wave_defs() wraps a flat entry as a one-element roster. Ticket 15 (squad/progression prototype) adds three more encounters, reached outside encounterOrder (via CombatPrototype.list_launchable_encounters(), surfaced as extra Debug-app cards): 'pairAmbush' (two enemies, both scripted at the player every round -- demonstrates that a stance committed against one attacker leaves the other fully dangerous, ticket 15 checklist item 1), 'mixedCrew' (three enemies, one of each teaching archetype together -- the squad-tactics evaluation roster, checklist item 2), and 'gauntlet' (two waves fought back-to-back with no HP reset between them -- the sustained-power/readability check, checklist item 5). A squad entry's roster lives under 'enemies' (array of the same per-enemy fields the flat encounters use); a multi-wave entry's rosters live under 'waves' (array of 'enemies'-shaped arrays, fought in order). `script` is each enemy's deterministic committed-action cycle, always aimed at the player -- CombatPrototype only advances an enemy's own scriptIndex on a round it actually commits (a frozen or exhausted skip round doesn't consume a step). PROSE-REVIEW: every `name`/`intro`/`teaches` string here is new copy, drafted against CONTENT-GUIDE.md's tone bible.

brawler.name: The Brawler
brawler.intro: He squares up, all shoulders. Nothing subtle about what's coming.

knifeFighter.name: The Knife Fighter
knifeFighter.intro: Quick on her feet, blade held low. She won't telegraph much.

enforcer.name: The Enforcer
enforcer.intro: He's done this before -- watching for an opening, not just swinging.

pairAmbush.name: Pair Ambush
pairAmbush.teaches: single-target defence leaves other threats live
pairAmbush.intro: Two of them, spread wide. Whoever you watch, the other one's free.

mixedCrew.name: Mixed Crew
mixedCrew.teaches: squad tactics -- does one strategy dominate a mixed line-up?
mixedCrew.intro: A brawler, a blade, and someone who's clearly run this before. Three at once.

gauntlet.name: The Gauntlet
gauntlet.teaches: sustained power across waves -- no reset between fights
gauntlet.intro: First lot's just the warm-up. There's more waiting behind them.
